title: Remote by Design, Discovered by the World: The Story of 48° Nord
summary: Discover how 48° Nord in Alsace connects travelers with a remote, nature-led stay and local hospitality through Booking.com’s platform.
body_markdown:
### **Putting an Unconventional Escape on the Map**


At


[48° Nord](https://www.booking.com/Share-9UDyFx) , the changing seasons are part of the appeal, with colder weather and quieter winter months offering a different kind of escape. According to Emil Leroy, Managing Director, Booking.com helps the hotel connect with travellers across Europe who appreciate its distinctive approach to nature, simplicity and local hospitality.


Tucked into the wooded hills of Alsace, the hotel's minimalist, Scandinavian-inspired cabins offer an alternative to a conventional stay, where the changing seasons and the surrounding landscape are central to the experience.


For Emil, much of the hotel's character lies in its simplicity. Rather than offering a traditional luxury experience, 48° Nord invites visitors to slow down and reconnect with nature. Its remote location and unconventional approach appeal to a particular type of guest, but reaching those travelers can be difficult for a small, independent business.


Booking.com champions this uniqueness, and as its sole distribution partner, Emil emphasises that Booking.com’s global technology platform gives the property visibility beyond what it could achieve through its own channels to help attract prospective guests who truly “understand what makes 48° special”. That connection is particularly valuable outside the traditional summer season, when rain, colder temperatures and the changing landscape make the hotel's Nordic-inspired atmosphere especially distinctive.
